title: fix(i18n): the organisation is "Organization" and the running instance is "Environment" — retire "workspace" from the console (objectui#12851)
body:
Fixes #12851
Clause-②: yes

## What changed

The console used one noun, 「工作区」 / "workspace", for two different things. Per the maintainer's ruling on objectstack-ai/cloud#2939 (letter A, comment 6229029648): the organisation members and billing belong to is now 「组织」 / "Organization", the running instance is 「环境」 / "Environment", and 「工作区」 retires.

- **Keys stay; values change.** No `workspace.*` key, component or file name moved (`WorkspaceSwitcher`, `CreateWorkspaceDialog` keep their names), so `@object-ui/i18n`'s key set is unchanged.
- **The cloud home's button reads 「打开」 / "Open"** (cloud#2768 Q2, comment 6118501670), ⛔ not 「打开生产环境」 (objectui#11659 ruling 1). Its two hints each say in one line what an environment is, built on the card's sentence.
- **All ten shipped packs**, not four: see Deviations.
- Stored organisation names such as "NAME's Workspace" are not touched (ruling item 5). No default name for a new organisation is composed from a locale string anywhere in objectui (searched for the "'s Workspace" shape and every `workspace.default` reader), so there is nothing whose output changes.

Plus one string in the metadata-admin designer table (`packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts`, en and zh only, as that table has): `engine.packages.noCapability` "manage packages in this workspace" / 「在此工作区管理」 now says "environment" / 「环境」.

## Strings kept, with the reason

| key | zh | en | why it stays |
|---|---|---|---|
| `console.ai.workspaceTitle` | AI 工作区 | AI Workspace | Names the assistant's full-page work area (its subtitle: "Ask, inspect, and resume conversations"), a UI surface; it means neither the organisation nor an environment. |
| `engine.inspector.appNav.mode.default` (designer table) | 默认视图(工作台) | Default view (workspace) | Means an object's own default view in the app-nav inspector; zh already reads 工作台, not 工作区. Neither noun. |

Code comments and identifiers that say "workspace" are not user-facing and were left alone, except comments that quote a label this PR changes ("Open workspace" in `CloudOnboardingNext.tsx`, "My Workspaces" in `AppHeader.tsx`).

## Consumers touched, and why

The call-site gate (`pnpm check:i18n-keys`) requires every literal inline `defaultValue` to equal the `en` value it falls back for, so each changed key's inline default changes with it. No consumer held a hard-coded literal outside those defaults.

- `WorkspaceSwitcher.tsx`, `AppHeader.tsx`, `OrganizationsPage.tsx`, `CreateWorkspaceDialog.tsx`: inline defaults only (claimed files).
- `CloudOnboardingNext.tsx`: the doc comment that quoted "Open workspace" (claimed file).
- `HomeLayout.tsx`, `HomePage.tsx`, `QuickActions.tsx` (app-shell) and `apps/console/src/pages/auth/AuthLayout.tsx`: inline defaults only. Not in the claim; see Deviations.
- `CurrentOrganizationIndicator.tsx`, `OrgBadge.tsx`, console `LoginPage.tsx` / `RegisterPage.tsx`: untouched; nothing in them needed it.

## Deviations

1. **Ten packs, not four.** objectui ships ten locale packs and `pnpm check:i18n-drift` fails when an `en` value changes and any of the other nine does not follow (merge-base comparison, no carve-out but a waiver ledger). So `ar`, `de`, `fr`, `ko`, `pt` and `ru` follow too, with each pack's organisation and environment nouns (de Organisation / Umgebung, fr organisation / environnement, ko 조직 / 환경, pt organização / ambiente, ru организация / окружение, ar مؤسسة / بيئة). The waiver ledger was not used: it would have left six languages naming the organisation "workspace".
2. **Four consumer files outside the claimed list** (`HomeLayout.tsx`, `HomePage.tsx`, `QuickActions.tsx`, `AuthLayout.tsx`) changed their inline `defaultValue` literals only, because `pnpm check:i18n-keys` refuses a stale default. `AuthLayout.tsx` is the console's sign-in shell, not `LoginPage.tsx` / `RegisterPage.tsx`.
3. **`marketplace.install.noPermission`** carried "ask your workspace admin" in en and zh only; it now asks for the organisation admin, and the eight packs that had no such clause gained it, so the drift gate is satisfied by a faithful translation rather than a waiver.
4. **The designer table's `engine.packages.noCapability`** (two lines) is the same defect in a second string table.

## Tests

Existing tests that asserted the old strings, changed with them:

- `packages/i18n/src/__tests__/organizations-picker-vocabulary-5215.test.ts`: objectui#5215 settled the picker on "workspace"; the one-noun-per-pack invariant now runs the other way and covers all ten packs and the `workspace.*` organisation keys too.
- `packages/i18n/src/__tests__/organization-namespace-3546.test.tsx`: its namespace-separation probe read `organizations.title` as "Workspaces".
- `CloudOnboardingNext.test.tsx`, `CloudWorkspaceTimezoneNotice.test.tsx`, `AppHeader.myOrganizations.test.tsx` (a test name), `apps/console/.../WorkspaceTimezonePrompt.test.tsx`.

New pins, each rendering the real packs in zh-CN with an en control:

- `WorkspaceSwitcher.organizationNoun-12851.test.tsx`: 创建组织 / "Create organization".
- `AppHeader.organizationNoun-12851.test.tsx`: the avatar menu's 我的组织 and 创建组织 / "My Organizations".
- `OrganizationsPage.organizationNoun-12851.test.tsx`: heading 您的组织 / "Your Organizations".
- `CloudOnboardingNext.test.tsx`: button 打开 / "Open" and both hints.

Ablation, once per new pin (zh value put back to the old noun through `ablation-replace.mjs`, mutation proved on disk by anchor count and blob hash, restored, `git diff HEAD` empty after every leg): switcher red, avatar menu red, organisations heading red, cloud button red (2 tests), cloud hint red, pack pin (ja `organizations.mine`) red (2 tests).

Evidence at `034b96b` (local, foreground, under the shared verify lock):

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/`: 1537 files passed, 1 skipped; 14509 tests passed (at `aae54b4`; the only later change is `views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts`, after which `pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/` passed 542 files / 6119 tests).
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/i18n/`: 83 files, 1325 tests passed (at `aae54b4`, unchanged since).
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/i18n/ apps/console/` at `7e6943d`: 305 of 306 files passed; the one failure was the 3546 probe, fixed in `aae54b4` and re-run green. Console files unchanged since.
- `turbo run build type-check` for `@object-ui/i18n`, `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/console` and their dependency closure: 39 of 39 tasks successful.
- `eslint` on every changed file: 0 errors.
- `pnpm check:i18n-keys`, `pnpm check:i18n-drift` (35 en values changed, 315 pack values followed, 0 waived), `pnpm check:i18n-designer-parity`, `pnpm check:i18n-dead-keys`, `pnpm check:new-line-citations`, `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`, `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`: all exit 0.
